scenarios.name: Enable creation by selecting a template

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders
the catalog root has no direct template files

scenario_steps.name: the user opens the new-document template chooser for the first time in this fresh session
the user chooses Home before selecting any template
the selected template root has no direct template entries
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the standard metric assembly template
